name: Johanan
summary: Johanan son of Kareah was a captain who warned Gedaliah of a plot and later rescued the people Ishmael had carried off. Afterward he would not obey the word of the LORD through Jeremiah and led the people left in Judah away to Egypt.

key_moments.title: Warns Gedaliah of Ishmael's Plot
key_moments.description: Johanan came to Gedaliah at Mizpah and warned him that Ishmael had been sent to kill him. He secretly offered to kill Ishmael first, but Gedaliah would not let him.

key_moments.title: Rescuing the Captives
key_moments.description: When Johanan heard of the evil Ishmael had done, he went to fight him and caught up with him at the great waters in Gibeon. The captives gladly turned and came to Johanan, but Ishmael escaped to the Ammonites.

key_moments.title: Leads the Remnant to Egypt
key_moments.description: When Jeremiah told the people not to go to Egypt, Johanan and the proud men said he was speaking falsely. Johanan took all who were left of Judah, with Jeremiah and Baruch, and came to Tahpanhes in Egypt.
